fresnel: adj(W) = lambda k (x) k with W^{bd} = Z^{abcd}k_a k_c; lambda is the quartic Fresnel scalar, and det W vanishes identically
passivity_scope: Causality is global and structural. Passivity is verified over the tested band only, now narrowed by the adaptive scan. Global passivity is NOT claimed.
plane_wave: grad -> i*k, so k x E = omega*B and k x H = -omega*D
scope: A passing result demonstrates that the B3 constitutive model reproduces selected electromagnetic propagation observables of the target effective metric. It still does not establish a fabricated metamaterial, unit cell, antenna, coil, or experimental device.
sign_provenance: derived from the project's own e^{-i omega t} kernel; signs from a source using e^{+i omega t} are NOT copied
solver: 1D frequency-domain layered medium, scattering matrices with Redheffer star product; only decaying exponentials appear, so thick evanescent stacks do not overflow
